content: Cline: task header shows estimated cost updated after every API request from provider pricing, tokens in/out, cache hits, context-window bar; history sortable by cost/tokens; no cumulative page (issue #4540 requests analytics). Roo Code: cost next to token usage per message in chat history, reasoning tokens included, 'Max Requests' pause as the only guard, no running total (issues #6822, #7755 request totals and per-model breakdown; model switching mid-task corrupts totals). Aider: per-message cost printed, /tokens breaks down the payload (files, repo map, history); session total was a long-standing request (#257). OpenCode docs do not describe cost display. Pricing sources: LiteLLM model_prices_and_context_window.json (fetched at startup), api.litellm.ai/model_catalog, models.dev; OpenRouter now always returns usage with prompt/completion/reasoning/cached tokens and cost in credits. All tools label cost as an estimate.
